channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: The Message Behind Trump’s Threats of ‘Economic Warfare’ Against Iran
item.description: President Trump’s threats of an “economic D-Day” carry a clear signal to Iran that he does not want to go back to war.

item.title: NPR: What to know about this weekend's IndyCar race on the National Mall
item.description: Why is the car race in this part of D.C.? Will it be streaming? Who's paying for it? Here's what to know before the Freedom 250 Grand Prix hits the National Mall this weekend.

item.title: BBC News: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
item.description: Scientists say the "unprecedented event" will likely push up global temperatures in 2027 and put the UK at risk of a wetter, stormier autumn.

item.title: Al Jazeera: Philippines floods fuel anger over alleged corruption
item.description: Weeks of monsoon rain have flooded northern Philippines, where residents are demanding answers over alleged corruption.

item.title: Ars Technica: US distributor of China’s most popular humanoid robots pivots after US ban
item.description: FCC ban on foreign-made robots accelerated RoboStore’s US manufacturing plans.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Teen ‘After-Prom’ Kings in LA Monetized the High School Rager
item.description: The West Coast house-party scene has long been iconic. For these young, tech-savvy entrepreneurs, it was also inspiration for MyPlots, a party-promotion empire.

item.title: WIRED Science: The Super El Niño Won’t Fix the West’s Water Crisis
item.description: “People have talked about the Colorado River crisis for decades—we’re now in it,” says one expert. “Everyone you talk to is like, ‘Shit, man.’”

item.title: WIRED Business: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
item.description: The UK government is facing calls to cancel a sprawling health care contract with Palantir. The region of Greater Manchester insists it can do a better job itself.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Real Meaning of the Jason Arday Scandal
item.description: In a young Black professor’s academic misconduct, a “race-realist” found a “hook for a story.”

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Sobriety and Hormones Gave Anna Faris a New Lease on Life
item.description: “It turns out there’s a correlation between drinking and depression.”

item.description: The winner of a proposal to add concessions to Greenpoint’s tiny waterfront park has a patchy history.
